notes.title: Deck Compatibility ✅
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that our game is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck, offering you an enhanced gaming experience on the go. Here are the key features, if you already forgot about our game:

Multiplayer Support: Team up with friends or challenge opponents from around the world, wherever you are. Enjoy seamless multiplayer gameplay on the Steam Deck.
Offline Mode: No internet? No problem! Our game now features an offline mode, allowing you to enjoy your favorite gaming moments even when you're disconnected.

Invite friends to play pool on the go! 

Thank you all for trying our game, can't wait to share what we're cooking up next!
